name: Park Jae-hyun
bio:
Park Jae-hyun's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly during his mandatory military service, where he was assigned to a logistics unit supporting a local racing team. The precision and teamwork captivated him, leading him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering upon his discharge. After graduation, Park worked as a data analyst for a small racing outfit, honing his skills in race simulation and strategy optimization. He is now eager to prove himself as a strategist, believing that meticulous preparation and an innovative approach can overcome limited resources. Park is known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to quickly identify critical opportunities on the track.

While relatively new to the high-stakes world of professional motorsport strategy, Park possesses an unwavering commitment to data-driven decision-making. He approaches each race as a complex puzzle, meticulously analyzing historical data, weather forecasts, and competitor performance to develop optimal race strategies. Although his management skills are still developing, Park is a dedicated team player who values collaboration and open communication. His perfectionist tendencies drive him to constantly seek improvements and refine his strategies, ensuring that no detail is overlooked in the pursuit of victory.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted with a slight wave
physical.description: Park has a lean build and a focused gaze, often seen with a slight smile.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with racing strategy diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Prefers to work in complete silence, finding any background noise distracting.
